services.name: Venue & Rentals
services.desc: The Guild is committed to supporting arts and culture in our community by making rehearsal and performance space available to Yukon artists and organizations at affordable rates. To inquire about hosting your event in one of our spaces, please take a look at our online calendar to ensure your dates are available and then provide us with some details using this form. The Guild Hall is located on the traditional territory of the Kwanlin Dün First Nation and the Ta’an Kwäch'än Council. services.name: Venue rentals
services.desc: As a community theatre, The Guild is committed to supporting arts and culture in the territory by making rehearsal and performance space available to Yukon artists and organizations at affordable rates. The Guild Hall facility includes a black box theatre, a performance/rehearsal studio with a bar and kitchen (O.R./Other Room), and an outdoor performance venue called ‘Round Back. Our black box theatre, O.R. and 'Round Back outdoor space are all available for rentals outside of the Guild's production schedule.
